summary: Example inventory with ansible_interpreter_python_fallback and a playbook running which python and printing all python-related variables via query('varnames').
questions: How can I see which Python Ansible discovered on a host?
How do I print all variables matching a name pattern?

answer_card.title: Debug Python discovery
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: test_11
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - command: which python
      register: result
    - debug:
        var: result.stdout
    - debug:
        msg: |-
          {% for i in _vars %}
          {{ i }}:
            {{ lookup('vars', i)|to_nice_yaml|indent(2) }}
          {% endfor %}
      vars:
        _vars: "{{ query('varnames', '.*python.*') }}"
```
